headline: Veterans Day Event planning, meeting location change, UMass Lowell Hockey Night fundraiser, and City of Lights Parade float.
summary: The Lowell Veterans Commission will discuss plans for the Veterans Day event, a temporary meeting location change due to construction at the Lowell Telemedia Center, fundraising at UMass Lowell Hockey Night, and a float for the City of Lights Parade. The commission will also review the Veterans Recognition Program criteria, a proposed catchphrase, fund balance, and new business items.
items: Discuss new meeting location due to Lowell Telemedia Center construction; November meeting moved from 11/11/26 to 11/18/26
Plan Veterans Day event details, including speakers, music, Pledge of Allegiance, Benediction by Imogene Stulken, and other logistics
List potential guest speakers and invited guests for Veterans Day event, including Senator Steven Panagiotakos and others
Discuss reading of letter requested from Lt. Col. James Ogonowski (no response received)
Plan Humvee display, decorations, Taps, and moment of silence for Veterans Day event
Discuss UMass Lowell Hockey Night Veterans Day appreciation event, including thank you card and 'Pass the Helmet' fundraiser
Review Chapter 60 Community Funds for Veterans program for possible donations
Approve letter to UMass President Martin Meehan requesting coordination and student support for Hockey Night event; possible dates 11/6/26, 11/13/26, or 11/14/26
Discuss participation in Golden Gloves Veterans Appreciation Night
Plan float for City of Lights Parade with decorations and banners
Review Veterans Recognition Program criteria provided by James Gaffney
Discuss letters requesting nominations for Veterans Recognition Program
Discuss proposed catchphrase for Veterans Commission, to be submitted to CASE Office and Law Department
Discuss honoring Lowell High School ROTC student and Lowell Police Cadet for rescuing a child
Discuss Meet and Greet invites for future speakers, including State Representatives after elections
Discuss securing Lowell Memorial Auditorium for Veterans Day Event on 11/10/27
Note Wreaths Across America confirmed free participation application
Review Veterans Commission fund balance of $6,700.00 and discuss criteria for use
Discuss ordering banner reading 'Sponsored by the Veterans Commission of Lowell'
Discuss Veterans Commission Gmail account release and website/social media progress
Discuss ordering new business cards for the Veterans Commission
location: Council Chambers at City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell, MA
plain_text:
AGENDA
LOWELL VETERANS COMMISSION MEETING
DATE: Wednesday, 14th October 2026 at 5:00 PM
Location: Council Chambers at City Hall 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell, MA
Meeting:
a. Call to Order: 5:00 PM
b. Pledge of Allegiance
c. Roll Call Attendance
PARADISE, PAUL
GAFFNEY, JAMES III
COTE, RICHARD A.
HARMON, JAMES
PEEPLES, MICHAEL
CEROVAC, ROBERT
GAUTHIER, PHILIAS
PIMENTEL, NAYELI 
PEEPLES, JEAN, SUB COMMITTEE MEMBER
ERIC LAMARCHE, DIRECTOR OF VETERANS’ SERVICES
1. The meeting place of future Veterans Commission meetings is needed as the Lowell Telemedia Center is 
still under construction following a water leak. The Veterans Commission meeting, originally scheduled for 
11/11/26 (which falls of the Veterans Day Holiday) has been rescheduled to 11/18/26 and may be held at the
Lowell Telemedia Center (if available), with subsequent meetings being held on the 2nd Wednesday of the 
month.  The Mayor’s Receptions room was booked.  An alternate location for the 11/18/26 meeting could be
the Senior Center.
2. Veterans Day Events:
a. A flyer of event activities needs to be circulated.  The CASE Office will provide a flyer.
b. Eric is taking care of the food and refreshments for the event.
Additional details:
Military music played prior to the start of the event. The National Anthem.
Display on the visual screen: Sponsored by the Veterans Commission and the City of Lowell.
Opening remarks Eric Lemarche, Director of Veterans Services Lowell MA
Pledge of Allegiance.
Imogene Stulken, Minister, Campus Ministries at UMass Lowell to perform the Benediction.
Potential guest speakers and invited guests:
Paul Paradise, Chairman of the Veterans Commission Lowell MA
Speaker Secretary of Veterans Services of Massachusetts
Dr. Elizabeth Parrott, Director of the Lowell Vet Center
Senator Steven Panagiotakos.  Mellisa of the CASE Office confirmed he will be a part of the 
event.  Possible idea to have him present flowers to fallen soldier’s family.
Ted Serozynsky, Director Military and Veteran Services UMass Lowell
Honor Guard Lowell Police Department
Lowell Fire Department
Scouts of American
US Congress and State Congress invites
City of Lowell City Manager
City of Lowell Mayor and City Council members
Lowell High School ROTC
Speaker from Lowell Catholic High School to speak about the plaque dedication to Landry
Hidden Battles
Dept. of Veterans Affairs Bedford
VFW
National Guard
Bridge Club
Details of additional logistics of the event:
The reading of letter requested from Lt. Col. James Ogonowski (no response from our request 
for a letter).
Humvee displayed on the plaza of the Lowell Memorial Auditorium
Decorations, bunting, and flags
Play Taps – and a moment of silence
Closing remarks
3. UMass Lowell Hockey night (during the Veterans Day appreciation night).  An idea to have a giant thank 
you card for guests to sign honoring the service of Veterans to be delivered to the Veterans Administration 
Hospital Bedford, MA.  In addition, the idea of “Pass the Helmet” to raise funds to help Veterans in need.  
Eric LeMarche reported about a program called Chapter 60 Community Funds for Veterans that may be 
possible to help with donations.  Vice Chairman Robert Cerovac approved a letter to President Martin 
Meehan of the University of Massachusetts to help coordinate this event, as well as asking for support of the
students to join in the events of the Veterans Commission and help support the community.  A copy of the 
letter is attached and needs approval.  Possible dates include 11/6/26, 11/13/26. or 11/14/ 26.
4. Participation by the Veterans Commission at the Golden Gloves Veterans Appreciation Night.
5. City of Lights Parade:
a. The Veterans Commission will participate in providing a float in the City of Lights Parade to honor 
Veterans.  Chairman Paul Paradise offered his truck and flatbed to provide the transportation.  The 
Commission members will participate in decorating the float.  An idea to have a holiday tree 
decorated in red, white, and blue lights, an eagle at the top of the tree, American Flags, bunting, US 
Military logos, and banners saying sponsored by the Veterans Commission of Lowell.  Also, a 
banner “To All Veterans, Thank You For Your Service”.  The CASE Office will provide a link to this 
event when available.
6. The Veterans Recognition Program
Commission member James Gaffney has provided the following criteria for the program:  A Distinguished 
Lowell Veteran is a military veteran who has served honorably in the Armed forces of the United States of 
America and has made a significant contribution to the city or its residents. Lowell residence is not a 
requirement, but the contribution must be to this city. Suggestions for letters to organizations and dignitaries
are needed requesting their nominations for the Veterans Recognition Program.  A pop up display asking for 
recommendations for the program will be included on all Veterans Commission’s vendor tables during 
events.
7. Veterans Commission Member James Gaffney suggested the Veterans Commission should adopt a 
catchphrase and supplied several suggestions that will be submitted to the CASE Office and the Law 
Department of the City of Lowell for approval.
8. New Business:
a. Paul Paradise provided details of a Lowell High School ROTC Student and Lowell Police Cadet’s 
lifesaving heroics in saving an autistic child from drowning.  Plans are needed to honor the student at
a future meeting.
b. Meet and Greet invites to speak at the Veterans Commission meetings.  After the elections potential 
invitees include our State Representatives.
c. Secure the Lowell Memorial Auditorium for next year’s Veterans Day Event 11/10/27.  Wreaths 
Across America confirmed application for their participation and it is free.  Copy of the 
confirmation is attached.
d.  The balance of the funds for the Veterans Commission was updated by Eric.  The Balance is 
$6,700.00.  Details on the criteria for using the funds is needed and clarify if it would be up to the 
Veterans Commission members.
e. The ordering of a Banner for future events: “Sponsored by the Veterans Commission of Lowell” will 
be put in place soon.
f. Google email is soon to release the Veterans Commission GMail account, and the files will be 
available to access.  The Veterans Commission Website and social media platforms (Facebook page)
are still under construction.
g. Order new business cards for the Veterans Commission.
9. Approval of meeting Minutes of Veterans Commission meeting of 9/9/26.
_______________________________________________________________________
Regularly scheduled meetings of the Lowell Veterans Commission are held on the 2nd Wednesday of the 
month Lowell Telemedia Center, 246 Market St, Lowell, MA 01852 starting at 5:00 PM. The following is 
a list of scheduled meetings: September 9, 2026, October 14, 2026, November 11, 2026 (rescheduled to 
November 18, 2026), December 9, 2026, January 13, 2027, February 10, 2027, March 10, 2027, April 14, 
2027, May 12, 2027, and. June 9, 2027.
